title: The Telangana Pathology and Anatomy Act, 1955.
full_text: The Telangana Pathology and Anatomy Act, 1955. Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 195510 Act Number: 10 Enactment Date: 1955-09-27 Act Year: 1955 Short Title: The Telangana Pathology and Anatomy Act, 1955. Long Title: An Act to provide for the supply of unclaimed bodies of deceased person to teaching medical institutions for the purposes of pathology or anatomical examination and dissection. Department: Department of Health, Medical and Family Welfare Type: STATE Location: Telangana Schedule 1. The Schedule.
